# NovaCloud Ltd. — Managed hosting agreement

NovaCloud Ltd. supplies managed API gateway hosting for Project Atlas. The agreement renews on 2027-03-01 and Procurement owns the contract. The contracted service includes the gateway environment, certificate maintenance and a named escalation route during deployment windows. Additional application development is charged only after a written scope approval.

The monthly service pack contains availability records and details of planned maintenance. The contract owner checks whether an interruption falls inside an agreed maintenance window before approving an invoice adjustment. A reported application error is assigned for investigation even when the hosting platform remains reachable. The operations contact keeps the original event timestamps with the service ticket.

Changes to routing require a reviewed configuration file and a rollback copy. The provider confirms that the requested window is staffed before it accepts the change. An urgent certificate replacement may follow the emergency process, but the configuration record must still be completed on the next working day. A telephone request alone does not authorise a permanent routing change.

The agreement reserves two coordinated deployment windows per month. Unused windows do not accumulate as credits. Procurement must receive a charge estimate before an additional weekend window is booked. Test traffic should use the designated non-production entry point so that it is not included in the customer-facing availability figure.

The February renewal review will consider the unresolved action list and the forecast support demand. Finance has asked for service charges and approved change work to appear on separate invoice lines. The supplier account team will provide a continuity contact for holiday periods. There is no approved increase to the hosting capacity in the current purchase order.
